rawRecord.EXPERIMENTAL_ai_generated_description: ComplyHat generates audit-ready AI compliance documentation across 9+ regulatory frameworks including the EU AI Act, NIST AI RMF, ISO 42001, OCC SR 11-7, ECOA/Reg B, NAIC Model Bulletin, CMS-0057-F, and the Colorado AI Act. The server provides 14 compliance tools for bias testing, regulatory gap analysis, drift monitoring, and documentation generation compatible with Claude Code, Claude Desktop, and other MCP hosts.
